literal: By the fate of accruing (wealth), there arises the absence of sloth; by the fate of wealth in hand departing, there arises laziness.
translation: Through the destiny of prosperity, untiring effort arises; through the destiny of losing one's wealth, laziness takes hold.
modern: செல்வம் சேர்வதற்குக் காரணமான விதியினால் சோர்வில்லாத முயற்சி உண்டாகும்; கையில் உள்ள பொருள் அழிவதற்குக் காரணமான விதியினால் சோம்பல் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how destiny (ஊழ்) shapes a person's mental attitude and drive. When it is one's destiny to prosper (ஆகூழ்), an innate sense of untiring effort and perseverance (அசைவின்மை) arises, driving them to work hard. Conversely, when destiny decrees the loss of one's wealth (போகூழ்), laziness and apathy (மடி) naturally creep in, causing them to neglect their work. Thus, the author suggests that even our industriousness or laziness is directed by the unseen force of destiny.
